academy.name: D'code IAS Academy
academy.description: D'code IAS Academy is the premier civil services coaching institute in Anna Nagar, Chennai & Tamil Nadu, founded by Sudhagaran Sir (Former Mission Director, Naan Mudhalvan). The academy provides outcome-focused UPSC Prelims, Mains, Optional subjects (Public Administration, Sociology, Anthropology), and TNPSC Group 1, 2 & 4 preparation under personalized administrative mentorship.

address.street: 825, 1st St, G Block, Ranganathan Garden, Anna Nagar

contact.operatingHours: Monday to Sunday: 08:30 AM - 08:00 PM IST

leadershipAndFaculty.name: Sudhagaran Sir
leadershipAndFaculty.bio: Former Mission Director of Naan Mudhalvan who has mentored over 500+ UPSC aspirants, guiding candidates towards Top 10 All-India Ranks. Renowned for simplifying complex UPSC & TNPSC syllabi and building personalized performance feedback loops.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What makes D'code IAS Academy the best IAS academy in Chennai?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: D'code IAS Academy is led by Sudhagaran Sir, Former Mission Director of Naan Mudhalvan, providing direct 1-on-1 mentorship, daily answer writing feedback, small batch sizes, and a proven track record of top All-India Ranks.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Where is D'code IAS Academy located in Chennai?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: The academy is located at 825, 1st St, G Block, Ranganathan Garden, Anna Nagar, Chennai - 600040. Phone: +91 96000 60393.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What optional subjects are taught at D'code IAS Academy?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: D'code IAS Academy provides specialized 4-month optional coaching for Public Administration, Sociology, and Anthropology.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does D'code IAS Academy offer TNPSC coaching?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, bilingual (Tamil & English) TNPSC coaching is provided for Group 1, Group 2, and Group 4 with special focus on Unit 8 and Unit 9.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can outstation or working professionals join online classes?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, all courses (Mains Momentum, PCM Comprehensive, Optionals, TNPSC) are offered in both Offline and live/recorded Online modes with flexible timing.
